source_text.body:
Train team Muse agents to work in a small business
A small business owner spent three weeks training their team's Muse agents to do business work, using a subagent to verify output before submitting.
·
Nov 7, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The owner had all employees download Muse and spent three weeks training each agent on computer-based business work. They fed it precise instructions, used speech-to-text while working so Muse could turn that into task lists and reminders, split work into side chats to save tokens, and set up a shared note area in their CRM by creating a fake customer with a notepad so agents could coordinate and avoid duplicating tasks.
How it went
They say the business had its best October ever, even though it is usually their worst month, and it became the second-best month of the year financially. The account is enthusiastic but vague: they do not share the business specifics or hard performance numbers.
Worth knowing
Their main practical catch was token use: they say breaking tasks into side chats made Muse run much more efficiently.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
I run a small business, [type of business], and I want to train you to handle [recurring work, e.g. quoting, invoicing, customer follow-up]. Here are my examples and rules: [paste or link]. Do the task for [sample case], have a subagent check your output against my rules, and show me both the result and the checker's notes. Don't send anything to customers or submit anything until I approve it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MuseAgent/comments/1xpqwjh/muse_is_insane
